install.title: Install the app (Mac and phone)
install.why: Install NodiNote as an app: it opens from the Dock or home screen with its own icon, loads faster, and pages, covers, PDFs and write-ups you have opened keep working without internet. Free, no app store.
install.installed: Installed — you are using the app window.
install.macChrome: Chrome or Edge: click the Install icon in the address bar (or ⋮ menu → “Install NodiNote”). It appears in Launchpad and the Dock.
install.macSafari: Safari: File → Add to Dock. It appears in the Dock and Launchpad.
install.ios: iPhone/iPad (Safari): Share → Add to Home Screen.
install.android: Android (Chrome): ⋮ menu → Install app, or accept the prompt.
install.offlineNote: Offline: pages you have viewed and PDFs you have opened stay on the device; write-ups can be edited offline and sync when you are back online. The AI, search and adding new items need internet.

shortcuts.systemWeb: In a browser only the NodiNote player is controlled. Use the NodiNote Mac app to control other audio/video on the computer too.

shortcuts.typePauseMacApp: Typing pauses, stopping resumes. For another app (Mutolaa, YouTube…): start it with the play/pause shortcut here first, so NodiNote knows it is playing.
shortcuts.playerExplain: The player is the small window in the corner. Opened from a resource with “Listen and write”, a YouTube video or audio keeps playing while you move between pages — listen while you write the taqriz. Drag it anywhere, hide the video to keep only the sound; it pauses while you type and remembers where you stopped on your account.

taqrizAi.askEmpty: Select a word or passage in the taqriz and press “Ask AI”.

taqrizAi.qEssay: What could I write about this in my taqriz? Suggest 2–3 ideas.
taqrizAi.qDeeper: Explain in more detail, with examples.
taqrizAi.askNote: Answers draw on the work’s facts, your uploaded text and the AI’s knowledge. Check important facts.
taqrizAi.modeTranscriptHint: Writes what is said word for word, with spelling and punctuation corrected.
taqrizAi.modeNotesHint: Writes structured notes: key ideas, definitions, examples and quotations.
taqrizAi.deepHint: Works out unclear words from context; a bit slower but more accurate.
taqrizAi.autoInsert: Write into the end of the taqriz automatically
taqrizAi.start: Let the AI listen and write
taqrizAi.waitingPlay: Paused — writing continues when you resume
taqrizAi.noMedia: This resource has no video or audio. Add a YouTube identifier or an audio link on its page.
taqrizAi.cannotCapture: This file comes from another site, so the AI cannot hear it. Upload it to NodiNote or add a YouTube identifier.
taqrizAi.listenNote: Pause the video and correct the text in the taqriz any time. One AI request per minute.
taqrizAi.fullHint: The AI first studies the whole video or audio (topic, speakers, correct spelling of names and terms, sections), then writes it out from start to end. When ready, download it as PDF, Word, Markdown or TXT.
taqrizAi.fullDeepHint: Writes every part with the whole talk's context in mind — slower but more accurate.
taqrizAi.fullReady: Full text ready — you can download it
taqrizAi.fullNote: Runs while this page is open; if you leave, “Resume” continues where it stopped. One AI request per 1.5 minutes of speech (5 minutes for a konspekt).
taqrizAi.writeHint: The AI writes parts of your taqriz in your voice from your notes, quotes, the video's transcript / konspekt and what you have written so far. You see it before it goes in.
taqrizAi.selectFirst: Select some text in the taqriz first.

taqrizAi.selectionChanged: The selected text changed — select it again.
taqrizAi.bookHint: The AI writes in your voice, only from facts you gave; unknown details become [ … ].
taqrizAi.interviewHint: Like a biographer, the AI asks one question. Answer by speaking or typing and it becomes book prose.

tour.label: Guide
tour.welcomeBody: A personal notebook for everything you read, watch and learn. Let me show you the essentials in one minute.
tour.libraryBody: All your books and videos, each with its status (Planned → Reading → Read), rating and dates.
tour.addBody: Add a book or a video: type its title or paste a link — the rest fills in. Add a book’s PDF and you can read and listen to it here.
tour.notesBody: Every thought you marked is gathered here — with its page and book.
tour.reviewBody: The AI writes the most important questions from what you read and asks them again just before you would forget.
tour.assistantBody: Say what you need in plain words: add a book, make questions, explain… Send a book’s PDF and it does everything. It asks before every change. Daily limit: {limit}.
tour.writeBody: Write your own book — your life or your family’s story. The AI asks, you speak or type.
tour.readBody: A book with its PDF gets “Read” and “Audiobook” buttons. While reading, select text: “Quote”, “Note” or “Ask AI”.
tour.guideBody: The full guide lives in Settings: every section explained in plain words. Learn from there whenever you like. Enjoy!

write.title: Write a book
write.subtitle: Write your own book — about your life, your family's history or what you know.
write.heroTitle: Every life is a book worth reading
write.heroBody: Your childhood, family, teachers, trials and lessons… Written down now, they become the most precious legacy for your children and grandchildren. Starting is easy: the AI asks you questions, you answer by speaking or typing — it shapes the text into book prose.
write.tipInterview: The AI asks like a biographer and opens memories
write.tipExport: Export the finished book as PDF or Word
write.noBooks: No books yet — pick a template above to start.
write.bookSubtitle: Short description or who it is for

write.storageFull: Your space is almost full: {used} / {quota} MB
write.storageFullBody: Save your books to your computer via “Download → With audio and video” (web book or EPUB). Then remove big audio and video files you no longer need from the text to free space.
write.how1: Pick a template — chapters and guiding questions are ready.
write.how2: Speak or type: the AI asks questions and shapes the text like a book.
write.how3: When ready, download it as PDF, Word or EPUB.

audiobook.title: Audiobook
audiobook.needPdf: Upload this book’s PDF first. The AI reads it from start to finish, analyses it and reads it aloud in a professional voice.
audiobook.ready: The audiobook is ready — you can listen
audiobook.intro: The AI reads the whole book closely: its genre, tone, characters and how they speak, how hard words are pronounced, its chapters. Then it gives each character a fitting voice and reads the book fluently, like a professional narrator.
audiobook.step2: Finding the genre, tone and chapters…
audiobook.takes: Usually 1–3 minutes. The analysis continues even if you close the page.
audiobook.making: Preparing the voice… (20–60 s the first time)
audiobook.scanned: Scanned PDF: pages are read from the images.
audiobook.noCast: No characters with direct speech were found — the narrator reads everything.
audiobook.voiceChanged: Voice changed — the next parts use it
audiobook.limit: Today’s audiobook limit is used up. Continue tomorrow.
audiobook.voiceFailed: The voice couldn’t be prepared. Try again in a moment.
audiobook.failed: The analysis failed. Please try again.
audiobook.ttsQuota: Today’s free voice quota is used up: Google’s free tier allows only ~40 speech requests a day. Parts already made are kept — it continues tomorrow.
audiobook.textDraft: The book’s text. Speakers are marked in colour once the voice is ready.
audiobook.betaHint: In testing: voices are made within Google’s free limit, a few parts a day. Finished parts are kept.
audiobook.previewHint: Hear how this voice reads a passage of the book
audiobook.previewLimit: Today’s sample limit is used up (12 a day).

reader.title: Read the book
reader.noContents: No chapters found — read by pages.
reader.quoteHint: Save to Quotes with its page and highlight it
reader.noteHint: Save to Notes with your own thought and highlight it
reader.thought: Your thought (optional): why it matters, what it reminds you of…
reader.scanned: This PDF is scanned (images), so its text couldn’t be extracted. Open the PDF itself or listen to it as an audiobook — the AI reads it from the images.
reader.aiHint: Select a passage and press “Ask AI”, or ask anything about the book. The AI won’t reveal what happens after the page you are on.
reader.s2: Which characters have we met so far, and who are they?
reader.s3: Hard words on this page and what they mean
reader.findingContents: Preparing the contents… (the AI is finding the chapters in the whole book)
reader.originalHint: See the page as printed in the PDF (pictures, tables, ornaments)
reader.noMarks: No marks yet. Select a passage and press “Quote” or “Note” — it is kept here with its page.
reader.found: {n, plural, one {Found on # page} other {Found on # pages}}
reader.offlineHint: The book’s text is stored on this device — read it without internet
reader.offlineDone: Saved on this device — you can read it offline now
reader.offlineFailed: Not saved. Check the connection and try again.

social.title: Community
social.subtitle: Find other learners, follow them and see their public lessons.
social.feed: What the people you follow are reading
social.feedEmptyBody: Find someone and press “Follow” — their public lessons appear here.
social.privateBody: Its owner keeps it to themselves.
social.noPublicSelf: On a book’s page press “Private” to make it public.
social.selfPrivateNote: Your profile is private: others cannot see it. You can open it in Settings.
social.publicHint: Shown on your profile — press to hide
social.privateHint: Only you see it — press to make it public
social.profileIsPrivate: Public, but your profile is private — nobody sees it yet
social.privateProfileHint: Everything is visible only to you.
social.publicProfileHint: Others can find you and see the items you mark public. Notes, write-ups and files stay private anyway.
